other_required_controls.requirement: Only package-present used ports clocked/configured; exact GPIO AF, reset-safe net and kit control manifest remains open. GPIOJ is absent on U585; unbonded pads are not a license to invent package GPIO.
Cache enable and RCC interface-clock enable are distinct; DCACHE1 initially disabled for internal-only proposal. No external-memory access. ICACHE remap REN fields all disabled.
No ordinary RCC peripheral reset/enable bit. Bind LSI, option/debug settings, bounded start, EWI disabled, and one progress-feed owner before blocking peripheral activity.
Separate control/clock/retention registers are not represented as held-reset traffic engines. Final used-path and secret-clear manifest remains open.
